exact_test: For five predeclared paired seeds, compare the exact author-iDDPM SW2 and MSW2 at the largest and smallest SAD directions.

acceptance.pairwise: largest minus smallest is positive for every seed and both metrics
acceptance.uncertainty: the exact percentile 95% interval over all 5^5 paired bootstrap resamples is strictly above zero for both metrics
acceptance.integrity: all ten endpoint exact-setup and independent-checker flags pass
acceptance.negative_control: reversing endpoint labels must fail the positive-effect rule

scope: Historical/downscaled corroboration only. The source geometry used 16000 networks, not the paper-scale one million, and cannot verify Claims 1 or 4.
